video.title: AI欧腐《我的两个特工爸爸/My Two Spy Daddies》
video.desc:
Elite agents Elias and Roman, from rival organizations, marry under false pretenses for undercover missions and adopt Harper, a seven-year-old with X-ray vision. While they think they have the perfect cover, their daughter sees through their lies and secretly plays matchmaker. From suspicion to affection, this makeshift family becomes each other's true home. When identities are exposed and conspiracies emerge, the two join forces to fight back, carving a path to survival for their loved ones.
顶尖特工 Elias 和 Roman 分别隶属于敌对组织。为了执行卧底任务，两人在彼此隐瞒真实身份的情况下假结婚，并收养了拥有透视能力的七岁女孩 Harper。
他们自以为打造了天衣无缝的掩护，却没想到女儿早已看穿了他们的谎言，还暗中充当红娘，努力撮合两人。从相互猜疑到渐生情愫，这个临时拼凑起来的家庭，逐渐成为彼此真正的归宿。
当两人的身份暴露、重重阴谋浮出水面时，他们决定联手反击，为守护所爱之人杀出一条生路。
